:::{#def-complex-vector}
#### Complex vectors and matrices

A **complex vector** of length $p$ is a column vector
whose entries are [complex numbers](algebra.qmd#def-complex-number);
the set of all of them is denoted $\mathbb{C}^p$.
A **complex matrix** of size $m \times n$ is a matrix with complex entries;
the set of all of them is denoted $\mathbb{C}^{m \times n}$.

The **complex conjugate** of a complex vector or matrix
takes the [complex conjugate](algebra.qmd#def-complex-conjugate) of each entry:
$(\overline{\matr{A}})_{jk} \eqdef \overline{a_{jk}}$.

:::
